critical_code_review_comments: InspireMe.jsx first page load uses force=false so it can hit the 4h server cache from previous sessions and receive fewer than POOL_SIZE (12) recipes — this is why the test observed pool=8 breakfast ideas. The 'N ideas' text (which shows pool.length) will vary based on what's cached. Not a bug — acceptable per spec ('≥6, ideally ~12'), but worth noting for UX: users may see 8 instead of 12 until cache expires or shuffle triggers a refill after a full cycle.

The shuffle button's spec calls for wrap detection at 'nextCursor < PAGE_SIZE'; when pool.length is not a clean multiple of PAGE_SIZE (e.g. pool=8, cursor jumps 0→3→6→1→4→7→2→5→0), refillPool will trigger earlier than expected. Works but slightly imprecise.
